Linux Commands in Read-World:

Commands:


ls  cp  find  |  xargs  cat  |  grep  |  sort  |  uniq  >  >>

串联命令：


find  =>  xargs  ==>  cat

查找文件 到 处理文件内容


find . -type f -name `"*.txt"`

mkdir -p ./test

ls .

cp ./test ./test.backup

ls ./

cd ./test

touch test{1..3}.txt

ls .
